briefing: Markets were modestly weaker today with NASDAQ -0.8% and S&P 500 -0.6%, a neutral-to-slightly-negative session rather than a clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Despite the soft tape, AAPL and HALO showed the full set of bullish confirmations (MACD crossover, rising momentum, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge), so we used two of our three open slots to deploy some idle cash into genuinely high-conviction setups while keeping one slot and cash in reserve given the mixed market.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: This means waiting for several technical indicators — like MACD, RSI, price versus moving average, and trading volume — to all agree before trusting a buy signal. When all signals line up, it suggests real buying interest rather than random noise, which is why today's buys were chosen even though the overall market was flat-to-negative.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 這是指等待多個技術指標(例如MACD、RSI、股價與移動平均線的關係,以及成交量)同時發出一致訊號,才相信買入訊號是可靠的。當所有訊號一致時,代表市場上有真實的買盤支持,而非隨機波動,這正是即使大市整體偏弱,今日仍選擇買入的原因。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted lower today in a broad, low-conviction pullback rather than a reaction to any single catalyst, with NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500 slightly. Growth and tech-adjacent names were among the softer performers, consistent with a mild risk-trimming day rather than a rotation out of equities. No major company-specific headlines were the primary driver; the move looks more like routine profit-taking after recent gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大型指數普遍小幅走弱,屬於較廣泛、缺乏明確方向的回調,並非單一事件所觸發,納斯達克表現略遜於標普500指數。科技及成長股表現相對疲弱,反映市場情緒偏向溫和減碼而非全面撤出股市。今次波動未見明顯的個股或政策消息主導,較像是近期升勢後的獲利回吐。

trades.reasoning: Full signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a liquid mega-cap that diversifies away from existing tech/semi concentration.
All five technical signals confirm institutional participation and the biotech exposure diversifies the portfolio away from current tech/semiconductor-heavy holdings.
